There is no clear visual hierarchy on the screen, which makes it a dangerous tool for trading. Everything seems to have the same level of importance. The button to sell a million-dollar position is the same size, weight, and color as a button to read a tangential news article or view a tutorial. This lack of visual distinction is dangerous and shows a poor understanding of a user's focus. Critical actions, like executing a trade or canceling an order, should be clearly highlighted and separated from non-critical, informational elements. This app’s flat, uniform design language makes it easy to get lost or to accidentally tap on the wrong element with potentially disastrous consequences. It’s an accident waiting to happen, born from lazy and indifferent design.
